title: Executive Transition Handbook and All-Staff Brief — Q2 Planning
body:
DRAFT — internal working doc. NOT FOR EXTERNAL DISTRIBUTION.

Purpose:
This handbook is a compact set of artifacts and a single source of truth for the next 6 weeks that ties together: the executive transition timeline, how we cascade Q2 OKR decisions, and the run-of-show and talking points for an all-staff briefing. Aim is to make the change predictable, minimize anxiety, and keep product delivery cadence intact.

Context / Why this exists:
- Founders will shift day-to-day exec operations next month; interim leadership and role reassignments are in flight.
- We need a clearly staged comms plan aligned with OKR re-prioritization and the company all-staff so ICs and managers know what to expect.
- This doc blends checklist + talking notes + draft OKRs to speed approvals and reduce rework.

High-level timeline (working):
- Week 0 (Mar 15): Internal exec sync — confirm final handoff matrix. Owners: Marcus + Priya.
- Week 1 (Mar 22): Leadership message + private manager Q&A. Managers receive fuller brief and FAQ. Owner: Priya.
- Week 2 (Mar 29): Company all-staff (30–40min) + public comms (blog + press). Owner: Evan.
- Week 3 (Apr 5): OKR freeze for engineering & product; routing for minor edits. Owner: Samantha.
- Week 4 (Apr 12): Team-level kickoff sessions and hiring/retrospective blockers triage. Owner: respective managers.

Audience & distribution plan (short):
- Primary: managers (private brief + Q&A the week before all-staff).
- Secondary: all staff (30–40min live + recorded + short TL;DR doc).
- Tertiary: external stakeholders (post-brief blog and press — coordinated with comms).

All-Staff Run of Show (target 35 minutes)
- 0:00–02:00 Opening (Marcus) — tone and what's changing; high-level reassurance (short).
- 02:00–10:00 Why this change, continuity plan (new interim exec context + handoff commitments).
- 10:00–20:00 Q2 northstar and proposed OKR adjustments (product & platform leads).
- 20:00–28:00 People/Care/Support: manager resources + where to go for help (Priya).
- 28:00–35:00 Live close + 72hr follow-up: where to find the FAQ and manager office hours.

Talking notes — key framing (short bullets to preserve voice):
- Change is procedural not product-driven; our product roadmaps and customer commitments stay prioritized.
- We are focused on minimizing context switching for engineering teams — two protections: OKR freeze window and backlog triage.
- Managers will get a private Q&A the week prior; escalate sensitive questions to people-ops.

Draft OKRs (PROPOSAL for leadership review)
Objective A: Keep customer SLAs and reliability stable during the transition
- KR A1: Mean 99th percentile inference latency under SLA for top 10% of customers — maintain <= baseline + 5% (owner: Platform SRE).
- KR A2: Post-deploy rollback rate <= 1% for all Redwood-hosted models (owner: Release Engineering).
- KR A3: Incident-to-resolution median <= 45 minutes for Sev1 in next 60 days (owner: SRE).

Objective B: Prevent quality/regression on production serving while enabling leadership handoff
- KR B1: Run 3 targeted evals on high-volume prompts with no >5% regression in quality compared to April baseline (owner: Applied ML).
- KR B2: Complete rollout of prefix KV cache for top 3 customer workload patterns (owner: Serving Runtime).
- KR B3: Deploy fallback routing policy for critical customers in two regions (owner: Smart Routing).

Objective C: Keep the company aligned and informed (people-first) during the transition
- KR C1: Managers report >80% confidence in next-step clarity in manager Q&A survey (owner: People Ops).
- KR C2: Publish FAQ and recorded all-staff within 24 hours; track views and follow-up items (owner: Comms).
- KR C3: Hold 12 team-level alignment sessions in the first two weeks following all-staff (owner: Team Leads).

Notes on metrics and levers (short):
- Where possible, trade off cost vs latency with explicit rollback plan; document suspected trade-offs in the suggestions repo.
- Any OKR that touches SLAs must include rollback criteria and owner-assigned runbook link.

Comms artifacts (deliverables and owners):
- Manager slide deck + private FAQ (Priya) — due Mar 18.
- All-staff deck + pre-reads (Evan) — due Mar 25.
- Blog + external comms (Comms partner; Evan) — draft Mar 29, publish after all-staff.
- FAQ doc (live page) (Priya & People Ops) — publish within 24 hours of all-staff.

Manager Q&A (private) — suggested agenda topics:
- Clarify handoff matrix & escalation paths.
- Hiring and open headcount triage during transition.
- How to communicate to direct reports who ask about leadership stability.
- What to do if product commits are at risk.

Risk register (top items):
- Risk: Rumors or external leaks before planned comms. Mitigation: embargoed manager brief and NDA reminder. Owner: Comms.
- Risk: Teams pause velocity due to uncertainty. Mitigation: Floating task force to triage critical backlogs; OKR freeze helps protect runway. Owner: Product + SRE.
- Risk: Too many last-minute OKR edits. Mitigation: One-week freeze window + triage queue. Owner: Product Ops.

Open questions / TODOs (notes to self):
- Q: Should we include a short video from the founders or keep it text-only? Pros/cons listed in comments. (Evan to advise.)
- Q: Do we move forward with the external blog the same day or wait 24hrs? (Comms preference: wait 24hrs.)
- TODO: Get legal sign-off on press language for leadership transition (Marcus).
- TODO: Wire manager feedback survey live by Mar 20 (Samantha).

FAQ snip (for manager prep):
- Will product roadmaps change? Short answer: No major shifts for Q2; minor rescheduling possible under the OKR triage process.
- Who covers the founder responsibilities? Interim exec assignments listed in the handoff matrix in Confluence.
- Where do I send direct reports' questions? Manager-only channel in Slack + scheduled manager office hours.

Action items (this doc's immediate owners)
- Marcus: finalize handoff matrix and legal check by Mar 12.
- Priya: manager slide deck + FAQ ready for Mar 18.
- Evan: all-staff deck draft by Mar 22; coordinate recording + publishing.
- Samantha: launch manager survey and summarize by Mar 23.

Appendix: handoff matrix (short format, inline)
- Founders daily ops -> Interim COO (Evan Chen) for 30 days.
- Product escalation -> Head of Product (Samantha Ortiz).
- People escalations -> VP People Ops (Priya Nair).

References / links: Confluence exec handoff page, JIRA OPS-1123 (transition tasks), comms checklist doc.

Tone guidance for managers (short): keep it calm, factual, emphasize continuity, point to resources (FAQ + manager office hours).

Versioning and review:
- v0.1 (this file): working draft for leadership review.
- v0.2: post-leadership edits, pre-manager distribution.
- v1.0: final after manager Q&A incorporated.

Last notes (honest):
- This doc intentionally conservative on timeline to avoid surprise changes. Expect small calendar shifts.
- Feedback loop: add comments in doc and flag items with high urgency via Slack @Marcus.

---
End of draft.
